engine.text: gdk {version:gdk} (C++ for multisig, Rust for singlesig), linked as a prebuilt static library

chain_data.text: Singlesig: Blockstream's Electrum server, replaceable with a personal Electrum server in Settings. Multisig: Blockstream's Green backend, not replaceable.

third_party.text: Nobody for singlesig accounts. 2-of-2 and 2-of-3 multisig accounts need Blockstream's server to co-sign every spend made in the app.

libraries.text: gdk (libwally-core, rust-bitcoin, Tor), Liquid Wallet Kit, Greenlight SDK, Firebase, Countly, Zendesk, Rive, Charts, SwiftCBOR, AsyncBluetooth

bitcoin_library_not_counted: libwally-core, rust-bitcoin, rust-elements (inside the prebuilt gdk)

prebuilt.text: gdk static library (libgreen_gdk_full.a) from Blockstream's release tarballs, checked against pinned SHA-256 sums; Google's grpc-binary and abseil-cpp-binary packages

patched: Countly's iOS SDK comes from a fork (angelix/countly-sdk-ios 23.6.1-ave). gdk's own build patches libevent and bc-ur, outside the app.
